spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:6:3: command demo: flag "name" sets layout but its type is string — layout says how a time is written, so it applies to time, datetime and date
spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:6:3: command demo: flag "due" sets layout "YYYY-MM-DD", which contains no part of Go's reference time, so no value could ever match — Go layouts write the reference time Mon Jan 2 15:04:05 MST 2006 the way yours is, e.g. "2006-01-02" for a date (or use unix / unixmilli)
